source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Unit 7 (PDF 128-144), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 7 (Permutation and Combination) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 State the Fundamental Principle of Counting. Use it to find the number of outfits made from 3 shirts, 4 trousers and 2 pairs of shoes.
(Ginti ka bunyadi usool (Fundamental Principle of Counting) bayan karein. Is se 3 shirts, 4 trousers aur 2 jooton se kitne libaas bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar aik event \(m\) tareeqon se aur us ke baad doosra \(n\) tareeqon se ho sake to dono aik saath \(m \times n\) tareeqon se. Libaas: \(3 \times 4 \times 2 = 24\).

book_ref.quote: then the total number of ways that the two events together can occur is the product of m and n.

blocks.prompt:
2 Two dice are rolled and then four coins are tossed. How many outcomes are possible altogether?
(Do dice phenke jate hain aur phir chaar sikke uchhale jate hain. Kul kitne nataij mumkin hain?)

book_ref.quote: This principle can be extended to three or more events.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define \(n!\) and write the value of \(0!\).
(\(n!\) ki tareef karein aur \(0!\) ki qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Musbat integer \(n\) ke liye \(n! = n(n - 1)\cdots 2 \cdot 1\), yani pehle \(n\) natural numbers ka hasil-e-zarb. Tareef se \(0! = 1\).

book_ref.quote: We call this product the factorial of

blocks.prompt:
4 Evaluate \(\frac{11!}{9!}\).
(\(\frac{11!}{9!}\) ki qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: never multiply everything out, cancel first

blocks.prompt:
5 Evaluate \(\frac{6!}{3!\,2!}\).
(\(\frac{6!}{3!\,2!}\) ki qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Cancelling factorials like ordinary numbers

blocks.prompt:
6 Write \(12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10\) in factorial form.
(\(12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10\) ko factorial ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(12!\) tak poora kar ke \(9!\) se taqseem: \(12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10 = \frac{12!}{9!}\).

book_ref.quote: is the top part of a factorial

blocks.prompt:
7 Show that \((2 \cdot 3)! \ne 2! \cdot 3!\).
(Dikhayen ke \((2 \cdot 3)! \ne 2! \cdot 3!\).)
blocks.explanation: \(6! = 720\), jab ke \(2! \cdot 3! = 12\). \(720 \ne 12\), is liye hasil-e-zarb ka factorial factorials ka hasil-e-zarb nahin.

book_ref.quote: Writing \((2 \cdot 3)! = 2! \cdot 3!\)

blocks.prompt:
8 Find \(n\) if \(\frac{n!}{(n - 2)!} = 30\).
(Agar \(\frac{n!}{(n - 2)!} = 30\) ho to \(n\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Factorials cancel karein aur quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Factorials grow very fast:

blocks.prompt:
9 Define a permutation. Are AB and BA the same permutation of the letters A and B?
(Permutation ki tareef karein. Kya AB aur BA aik hi permutation hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi set ki tamam ya kuch cheezon ki khaas tarteeb permutation hai. AB aur BA mukhtalif hain kyunke tarteeb mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: An arrangement of all or part of a set of objects in a specific order is called a permutation.
The product form has exactly

blocks.prompt:
11 Use \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\) to explain why \(0!\) is taken as \(1\).
(\({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\) se wazeh karein ke \(0!\) ko \(1\) kyun liya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Tamam \(n\) cheezon ki tarteeb \(n!\) hai. Formula \(\frac{n!}{0!}\) deta hai. Dono barabar hon to \(0! = 1\).

book_ref.quote: Reason for defining 0! = 1

blocks.prompt:
12 How many arrangements of all the letters of the word NUMBER are possible?
(Lafz NUMBER ke tamam huroof ki kitni tarteeben mumkin hain?)

book_ref.quote: AB and BA are two different permutations

blocks.prompt:
13 How many 5-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 if no digit is repeated?
(Digits 1 se 7 tak se baghair dohraye kitne 5-digit numbers ban sakte hain?)

book_ref.quote: the order of the digits matters

blocks.prompt:
14 How many even 4-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 without repetition?
(Digits 1 se 7 tak se baghair dohraye kitne jufat (even) 4-digit numbers?)

book_ref.quote: The thousands place has 6 choices, then 5, 4 and 3 for the remaining places.

blocks.prompt:
15 In how many ways can 6 people sit on a bench if two particular people must sit together?
(6 log bench par kitne tareeqon se baith sakte hain agar do khaas log saath baithen?)
blocks.explanation: Do ko aik unit: \(5! = 120\); andar \(2!\); kul \(240\).

book_ref.quote: A group that must stay together is treated as one unit (block)

blocks.prompt:
16 7 different books are placed in a row so that 3 particular books are always together. Find the number of arrangements.
(7 mukhtalif kitaben qataar mein, 3 khaas kitaben hamesha ikatthi. Tarteeben nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Forgetting the arrangements inside a block

blocks.prompt:
17 How many 3-letter codes can be made from A to Z (i) without repetition (ii) with repetition?
(A se Z tak kitne 3 huroof ke codes (i) baghair dohraye (ii) dohrane ke saath?)

book_ref.quote: assumes no object is used twice

blocks.text: 7.3 Permutation of Objects Not All Different

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the number of arrangements of all the letters of the word LETTER.
(Lafz LETTER ke tamam huroof ki tarteeben nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If we exchange the 2 Ts, we can see there are 2! ways to write the same word.

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the number of arrangements of all the letters of the word TOMATO.
(Lafz TOMATO ke tamam huroof ki tarteeben nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A letter that appears once contributes

blocks.prompt:
20 Find the number of arrangements of all the letters of the word COMMITTEE.
(Lafz COMMITTEE ke tamam huroof ki tarteeben nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: M, T, E do do dafa: \(\frac{9!}{8} = 45360\).

book_ref.quote: Adding the repeats instead of taking their factorials

blocks.prompt:
21 In how many different ways can 5 identical red beads and 3 identical blue beads be placed in a row?
(5 aik jaise laal aur 3 aik jaise neele motiyon ko qataar mein kitne tareeqon se?)

book_ref.quote: Why divide? If the letters were all different we would get

blocks.prompt:
22 How many arrangements of the letters of BALLOON begin with B?
(BALLOON ki kitni tarteeben B se shuru hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: B pehle; baqi A, L, L, O, O, N: \(\frac{6!}{2!\,2!} = 180\).

book_ref.quote: so every real word has been counted

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a circular permutation? In how many ways can 6 people sit at a round table?
(Circular permutation kya hai? 6 log gol mez par kitne tareeqon se baith sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Daire ki tarteeb circular permutation hai. 6 log: \(5! = 120\).

book_ref.quote: The permutation in which the objects are arranged in a circular order is known as circular permutation.

blocks.prompt:
24 How many different necklaces can be made from 7 beads of different colours?
(7 mukhtalif rang ke motiyon se kitne mukhtalif haar?)

book_ref.quote: because the necklace can be turned over

blocks.prompt:
25 Why do we divide by 2 for garlands but not for people at a round table? Find the number of garlands of 8 different flowers.
(Garland ke liye 2 se taqseem kyun karte hain magar gol mez ke logon ke liye nahin? 8 mukhtalif phoolon ke kitne garland?)
blocks.explanation: Garland palta ja sakta hai, is liye tarteeb aur us ka aks aik; mez ke log palte nahin. Garland: \(\frac{7!}{2} = 2520\).

book_ref.quote: Dividing by 2 for people at a table when the question has not said

blocks.prompt:
26 Define a combination and write the formula for \({}^{n}C_{r}\).
(Combination ki tareef karein aur \({}^{n}C_{r}\) ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(n\) mein se \(r\) cheezon ka intikhab (subset), jis mein tarteeb ahem nahin: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n - r)!}\).

book_ref.quote: So, each combination will give rise to

blocks.prompt:
27 Evaluate \({}^{10}C_{3}\).
(\({}^{10}C_{3}\) ki qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Short rule: on top, multiply

blocks.explanation: nC2 ko n(n - 1)/2 likh kar hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Forgetting one factorial in the denominator
Each group of 2 appears twice in the permutation list
there is only one way to choose nothing

blocks.prompt:
31 10 people each shake hands once with every other person. How many handshakes take place?
(10 log har doosre se aik dafa haath milate hain. Kitne handshakes?)

book_ref.quote: Ask whether order matters before you start.

blocks.prompt:
32 How many straight lines can be drawn through 9 points in a plane, no three of which are on one line?
(Satah mein 9 nuqte, koi teen aik line par nahin. Kitni seedhi lines ban sakti hain?)

book_ref.quote: A combination of \(r\) objects taken out of \(n\) objects is a subset of

blocks.prompt:
33 Decide whether each count is a permutation or a combination: (i) choosing 4 players from 11 (ii) giving 1st, 2nd and 3rd prizes to 3 of 20 students.
(Batayen har ginti permutation hai ya combination: (i) 11 mein se 4 khilari chunna (ii) 20 mein se 3 talaba ko pehla, doosra, teesra inaam dena.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Combination: wohi 4 khilari kisi bhi tarteeb mein wohi group. (ii) Permutation: inaam badalne se naya nateeja.

book_ref.quote: If I change the order, do I get a new answer?

blocks.text: 7.4.1 Applications of Combination in Real Life

blocks.prompt:
34 A pizza shop offers 7 toppings. In how many ways can a customer choose 3 toppings?
(Pizza shop par 7 toppings. Customer 3 toppings kitne tareeqon se chun sakta hai?)

book_ref.quote: In everyday life we often choose a few things from many and do not care about the order

blocks.prompt:
35 From 7 men and 5 women, in how many ways can a group of 2 men and 2 women be chosen?
(7 mardon aur 5 auraton mein se 2 mard aur 2 auraton ka group kitne tareeqon se?)

book_ref.quote: choose the girls and the boys separately and multiply

blocks.prompt:
36 A team of 5 is chosen from 9 players. How many teams (i) include a particular player (ii) leave him out?
(9 khilariyon mein se 5 ki team. Kitni teams (i) aik khaas khilari ke saath (ii) us ke baghair?)

book_ref.quote: the remaining 3 places must still be filled with boys

blocks.prompt:
37 A committee of 5 is chosen from 7 men and 5 women. How many committees have at least 4 women?
(7 mardon aur 5 auraton mein se 5 ki committee. Kam az kam 4 auraton wali kitni?)
blocks.explanation: Cases mein taqseem kar ke jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Girls AND boys are chosen together, so multiply.

blocks.prompt:
38 How many triangles and how many lines can be formed from 10 points, no three of which are on one line?
(10 nuqton se, koi teen aik line par nahin, kitne triangles aur kitni lines?)

book_ref.quote: Choosing 5 fruits to put in is the same as choosing 3 fruits to leave out

blocks.prompt:
39 State the result on complementary combinations and use it to evaluate \({}^{12}C_{10}\).
(Complementary combinations ka nateeja bayan karein aur \({}^{12}C_{10}\) nikalein.)

blocks.prompt:
42 Find the number of diagonals of a 7-sided and of a 9-sided polygon.
(7 sides aur 9 sides wale polygon ke diagonals nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A diagonal joins two vertices that are not next to each other

blocks.prompt:
43 A polygon has 20 diagonals. How many sides does it have?
(Aik polygon ke 20 diagonals hain. Is ke kitne sides?)
blocks.explanation: nC2 - n = 20 rakh kar hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Forgetting to subtract the sides when counting diagonals

blocks.prompt:
44 Write two differences between a permutation and a combination.
(Permutation aur combination mein do farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Permutation tarteeb hai (order ahem); combination intikhab hai (order ahem nahin). Aur \({}^{n}P_{r} = r!\,{}^{n}C_{r}\).

book_ref.quote: Difference between permutation and combination (as printed)

blocks.prompt:
45 A 4-digit PIN uses the digits 0 to 9. How many PINs are possible (i) without repetition (ii) with repetition?
(4-digit PIN digits 0 se 9. Kitne PIN (i) baghair dohraye (ii) dohrane ke saath?)

book_ref.quote: in a password the order matters

blocks.prompt:

(Gulukar 8 mein se 3 gaane chunta hai. Kitne tareeqe agar (i) tarteeb ahem ho (ii) ahem na ho?)
